```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
library(pollinatorSDM)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 1. Espèces étudiées

- *Apis mellifera*
- *Bombus terrestris*
- *Bombus lapidarius*

## 2. Données d'occurrence

```{r}
occ <- download_pollinator_data(limit = 30)
occ_clean <- clean_occurrences(occ)$cleaned
```

Occurrences nettoyées : `r nrow(occ_clean)` points.

## 3. Modèle SDM

```{r}
n <- 50 * 50
ext <- c(-10, 10, 30, 50)
r1 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = rnorm(n, 15, 10))
r2 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = rgamma(n, 2, 0.01))
r3 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = sample(1:5, n, replace = TRUE))
r4 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = runif(n, 0, 3000))
env <- c(r1, r2, r3, r4)
names(env) <- c("temperature", "precipitation", "landcover", "elevation")

preds <- prepare_predictors(occ_clean, env)
preds$presence <- 1
bg <- generate_background_points(env, n = 500)
bg$presence <- 0
model_obj <- train_sdm_model(preds, bg)
model <- model_obj$model
ev <- evaluate_models(model, bg)
```

AUC : `r round(ev$metrics$AUC, 3)`

## 4. Carte de distribution

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
pred <- predict_pollinator_distribution(model, env)
plot_pollinator_map(pred, "Suitabilité des pollinisateurs")
```

```{r}
crops <- import_crop_data()
crops
```

## 6. Déficit de pollinisation

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
pollination_index <- calculate_pollination_index(pred, env)
deficit <- calculate_pollination_deficit(pollination_index)
plot_pollination_deficit(deficit)
```
